description: PORTLAND, OR- Today, Deschutes County Commissioner and candidate for Oregon’s 5th Congressional District, Patti Adair, announced she won the Libertarian Party nomination for Oregon’s 5th Congressional District in addition to the Republican nomination. Commissioner Adair stated: “I am honored and humbled to win the Libertarian Party of Oregon’s co-nomination.
